title: Check the recorder before blaming the aircraft
summary: Logging rate, gaps, missing fields, and firmware-specific semantics determine which questions a log can answer.

blocks.text: Airframe recovers bounded damage where it can and reports log quality, frame gaps, recorded fields, and compatibility context. Recovery keeps usable neighbours; it does not turn missing samples into observations.

items: Confirm the selected segment and Betaflight version in Overview.
Read Log Quality, Recovered Gaps, Observed Main Rate, and Nyquist Limit.
Open Recorded Data to confirm the fields needed by the analysis were actually written.
Treat unavailable analyses as a property of this recording, not as a moral failing by the quad.

blocks.title: Compatibility is deliberately conservative
blocks.text: Airframe's supported baseline is Betaflight 4.4.3 with Blackbox Data version 2. Older logs are best effort until representative fixtures and golden comparisons exist.
